subject: general
question: Mendel did two experiments: (1) Pollen from tall plants was taken to fertilise ovules of short plants, and (2) pollen from short plants was taken to fertilise ovules of tall plants. If we compare the plants produced from these two experiments, we will see that _________.

options.text: experiment 1 will produce tall plants and experiment 2 will also produce tall plants
experiment 1 will produce tall plants and experiment 2 will produce short plants
experiment 1 will produce short plants and experiment 2 will also produce short plants
experiment 1 will produce short plants and experiment 2 will produce tall plants

solution:
The correct answer is __**experiment 1 will produce tall plants and experiment 2 will also produce tall plants**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pea Plants were famously used by Gregor Mendel in his genetic experiments.
 
• Mendel's Experiments with pea plants helped establish the fundamental laws of inheritance.
 
• Pea plants are easy to grow and have a relatively short generation time, making them ideal for genetic studies.
 
• They exhibit clear and distinct traits, such as flower color and seed shape, which are easy to observe and categorize.
